title: The AI Game Jam has started!
author: dgeisert
selftext:
The restriction we are using is that the inputs can only control player movement.  No button for shooting or interaction.  No UI menu buttons.

Theme is "Cat and Robot"

[https://itch.io/jam/jamference-ai-game-jam-hack-1](https://itch.io/jam/jamference-ai-game-jam-hack-1)

Come make a game in a week with us and see all the games that everyone else is making!

I'm going to be streaming playthroughs of all the games (assuming under 100).  About me: I'm David Geisert, I worked in the games industry for 14 years at Zynga, a number of startups, and Meta in the Oculus org.  I've worked as a game designer, developer, and product manager.
